item.description:
Nib’s floating interfaces now have a crisp animated gradient outline inspired by modern glass controls.

  • The outline moves slowly around dictation, edit, retry, and error surfaces.
  • The effect stays on the perimeter without bleeding into the glass and respects Reduce Motion.
  • The native-glass waveform no longer shows a rectangular backing layer.

Nib’s floating interfaces now have a soft, luminous edge inspired by modern glass controls.

  • The dictation capsule gains a brighter indigo-to-teal gradient rim.
  • The edit panel uses a quieter matching treatment that stays legible in light and dark mode.

Long dictations are now protected when the speech provider is busy or the connection drops.

  • Encrypted recording recovery is on by default and survives restarts.
  • Temporary failures retry the same audio up to three times.
  • Open Pending Dictations from Nib’s menu to retry, play, save audio, or delete a recording.
  • Recovered text opens for copying, with the same batch transcription and cleanup quality.

Manage recording recovery in Settings → Dictation → History.
